# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.60

- **Collections manager** for newspapers, magazines, books and other series (menu File, or the command palette; CLI: `legatorocr collection new | add | list | run | search`). A collection is a `.lgrcol` file in a folder you choose; each item has kind, title, number/date, languages, profile, status and notes; paths are stored relative to the collection so the folder can be moved. Adding a folder makes one item per file or subfolder, guessing the title from the name (`scinteia_tineretului_1977_09_8801.pdf` → newspaper, 1977-09, no. 8801 — a guess you can correct). Batch processing runs the items not done with their profile; one failing item does not stop the others; progress and Cancel. Full-text search over the OCR text of the whole collection with diacritics and old spelling folded ("Scînteia" finds "Scânteia"), results with item, page and snippet. Eight languages; documented in the README files and the guide.
- Includes pre.59 (gutter/border-band fix, PDF size target by resolution).

Known: the window was written and tested by unit tests and a CLI run, but its layout has not been looked at on screen by the author — please report anything that looks wrong. Search covers only text recognised by `collection run` (PDFs that already have a text layer are not indexed); opening a result opens the PDF at page 1; the index is read whole into memory (not measured on tens of thousands of pages).
